summary.name: Rumpelstiltskin Dance AI
summary.one_liner: A paid web tool that turns 1–2 uploaded adult photos into a short (about 10 s) 720p MP4 of a face-swapped barn tip-toe dance, with trend-style audio included.
use_cases: Make a tip-toe barn dance clip from a selfie
Create a short dance video without filming
Produce a meme-style dance clip for TikTok or Reels
Animate a pet photo into a dance short
Make a dance video with a friend from two photos
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a face-swap pipeline: the user uploads one or two clear adult face photos and the service maps them onto a fixed tip-toe dance reference clip, producing a roughly 10-second 720p MP4 with sound. The motion follows four beats (tip-toe entry, bounce, hype pose, closing flourish). Pricing is pay-per-render with credit packs; the page says failed generations return credit automatically. The audio is trend-style and included in the render, and the page states the tool does not sell or host commercial songs, so users must add a trending sound themselves if they prefer one. It is described as an independent fan tool, not affiliated with the meme creators or rights holders.
notable: Fixed four-beat tip-toe dance template, so motion is consistent across renders
Pay-once credit packs starting at $8.88 for one 720p clip, no subscription or app
Output MP4 includes trend-style audio; page says it is not an official music release
caveats: Adults 18+ only, and only authorized photos; no celebrity or music-video stills
Render links expire, so downloads must be saved promptly
Audio style may vary by model and is not an official release; users must add trending sounds in TikTok or Reels themselves if desired
